_comment: Gateway execution role template, build-contracts.md section 2.3 plus the Policy integration permissions from the AgentCore developer guide (policy-permissions): GetPolicyEngine on the policy engine and AuthorizeAction / PartiallyAuthorizeActions on the engine and the project's gateways (verified live 8 Oct 2026: CreateGateway with a policy engine fails with 'Access denied while calling GetPolicyEngine ... with Gateway role' without them). The shared policy engine is created by the admin in module 4 with a random id suffix, hence policy-engine/*. Placeholders: {{account_id}}, {{region}}, {{project_id}}, {{env}}, {{snake}}; the list placeholders {{allowed_tool_arns}} and {{kb_arns}} are replaced by the project's allowedToolArns and knowledge base ARNs, or by "*" when the list is empty (a project without tools or knowledge bases yet; tighten by PATCHing the project). Rendered by platform_sdk.templates.roles.render_gateway_role.
